title: Access requests

caption: Guide Négo access requests, oldest pending first.

forbidden.scope: Administer Guide Négo, across the whole platform
forbidden.description: Access requests are reserved for platform-wide administrators. An account scoped to a single event has no access to them.

approve.title: Approve {name}?
approve.question: The reserved modules will open at their next opening of the app, and an email will tell them so.
approve.network: The code they presented also grants network membership.

reject.title: Decline {name}'s request?
reject.question: An email will tell them so. The reason you write will be quoted as is.
reject.reasonHint: It is the only thing the person will read to understand.

empty.title: No request
empty.description: Nobody is waiting for an answer. That is the normal situation as long as admission is by code only.
